svg.title: SPATHI: population-aware gene-regulatory network inference
svg.desc: All preprocessed cells contribute to a separate network for each group through transcriptomic-similarity weights. Distance representations define sample weights; models use the supplied expression values. Weighted tree ensembles return directed, unsigned predictive TF-target hypotheses. All matrices, cell positions, weights and network edges shown are schematic, not experimental results.
